text:
evan: quick flag  two DPs expanded scope mid-sprint again. want a minimal scope-lock + healthscore we can attach to tickets.
sophia: agree. minimal flow: intake -> auto-score -> path assign (light/beta/pilot) -> scope-lock sign-off. scope-lock prevents new asks without re-score.
omar: make scoring deterministic and visible on the card. include: integration effort (1-4), data sensitivity (none/low/high), infra change (y/n), qps.
claire: short scoring pseudo: 
```
score = integration_effort + (data_sensitivity == 'high' ? 3 : data_sensitivity == 'low' ? 1 : 0) + (infra_change ? 2 : 0) + (qps >=100 ? 1 : 0)
# <=2 -> light, 3-5 -> beta, >=6 -> pilot
```
eos: small change: require "prompt escrow" checkbox. if unchecked -> tag "limited-eval" and deprioritize deep integrations.
ops-bot: automation: form webhook -> scoring lambda -> create tracker card with score + tags: scope-locked candidate, limited-eval, on-prem. auto-tag on keywords: "on-prem","VPC","private".
evan: scope-lock step: PD+ENG click to confirm -> add label "scope-locked" and freeze scope for sprint unless emergency triage.
sophia: launch gates (beta): owner assigned, sample prompts validated, perf smoke p95, docs quickstart, monitoring panel live, and partner signed commit to 2 feedback sessions.
omar: healthscore for post-launch (internal) idea: normalize metrics and weigh: pass_rate 50%, hallucination 20% (inverse), latency 20%, cost trend 10%. simple formula and thresholds green/watch/red.
claire: rollback triggers: healthscore <0.6 or cost delta >25% -> revert to previous model alias and notify partner with template.
evan: outreach snippet for DPs: "Hi {name}, thanks for interest. Quick ask: one-line problem, expected qps, data residency, willingness to share 30-100 sample prompts (Y/N), preferred path. We'll reply in 48h"
sophia: operational next steps: evan -> runbook & comms; omar -> scoring lambda; claire -> healthscore thresholds + dashboard widgets. ops-bot: reminder set for 5 business days in #product.
ops-bot: reminder scheduled.
